name: bh_mcg_threat
speaker: mcgonagall
text: Hogwarts is under threat. To the walls, all of you. Guard this school with everything you have.

name: bh_mcg_piertotum
speaker: mcgonagall
text: Piertotum Locomotor!

name: bh_mcg_quip
speaker: mcgonagall
text: I have been waiting years to cast that.

name: bh_flitwick_shield
speaker: flitwick
text: Protego Maxima. Fianto Duri. Repello Inimicum!

name: bh_neville_brilliant
speaker: neville
text: Brilliant.

name: bh_vold_fools
speaker: voldemort
text: Many of you mean to fight me. You believe it brave. It is only foolish.

name: bh_vold_hour
speaker: voldemort
text: Bring me Harry Potter, and I will spare every one of you. Refuse, and none of you will see the dawn.

name: bh_vold_begin
speaker: voldemort
text: Begin.

name: bh_ron_hold
speaker: ron
text: It won't hold. It can't.

name: bh_hermione_hold
speaker: hermione
text: It only has to hold long enough.

name: bh_nev_taunt
speaker: neville
text: Well? Come on, then! What are you waiting for?

name: bh_seamus_run
speaker: seamus
text: Neville! Run!

name: bh_nev_now
speaker: neville
text: Now, Seamus! Now!

name: bh_nev_ha
speaker: neville
text: Ha! Did you see that?

name: bh_ron_spiders
speaker: ron
text: Spiders. Why is it always spiders?

name: bh_hermione_run
speaker: hermione
text: Ron, run!

name: bh_vold_withdraw
speaker: voldemort
text: You have fought bravely, and I honour it. My forces will withdraw. See to your dead.

name: bh_bella_play
speaker: bellatrix
text: Oh, look at the little ones. Shall we play?

name: bh_molly_daughter
speaker: molly
text: NOT MY DAUGHTER, YOU WITCH!

name: bh_bella_children
speaker: bellatrix
text: Ha! And who will mind your brats when you are dead, hmm?

name: bh_vold_come_to_die
speaker: voldemort
text: Harry Potter. The boy who lived. And now you come to me to die.

name: bh_harry_finish
speaker: harry
text: Then let's finish it, Tom. Just you and me.

name: bh_harry_expelliarmus
speaker: harry
text: Expelliarmus!

name: bh_vold_avada
speaker: voldemort
text: Avada Kedavra!

name: bh_ron_elder
speaker: ron
text: That's the Elder Wand, mate. Nothing could stand against it. We'd never lose again.

name: bh_harry_dont_want
speaker: harry
text: I don't want it. It's done enough.

name: bh_narr_allwell
speaker: narrator
text: All was well.
